rule: Every listed failure is a permanent regression case. Closing a defect does not remove its regression test.

failures.title: Duplicate active decision identity
failures.required_rule: Duplicate active EDR ID is a hard configuration/control defect; exactly one current authority must remain.

failures.title: Conflicting controlled engineering values
failures.required_rule: A release-relevant characteristic cannot have different active values across EDR/Product Definition/CAD/drawing/analysis/inspection.

failures.title: Text-based semantic validation
failures.required_rule: A guard must validate structured values/provenance, not display strings.

failures.title: Rollback implementation failure
failures.required_rule: Rollback must be independently executable/tested and must not be assumed merely because a backup exists.

failures.title: State Epoch churn without engineering change
failures.required_rule: Same semantic authorities/frontier must yield the same State Epoch.

failures.title: Stale remote-tracking ref treated as GitHub freshness
failures.required_rule: Fresh remote state requires actual fetch/ls-remote before claiming GitHub freshness.

failures.title: Staged Git index stops unrelated engineering
failures.required_rule: Staged state is configuration work unless it invalidates active-workpack input identity.

failures.title: Artifact path reported but artifact unavailable
failures.required_rule: Creation message is not evidence; verify exists, nonzero size, hash, archive readability and required members.

failures.title: Center projection diverges from authority
failures.required_rule: Center is projection only; mismatch creates PROJECTION_HOLD, not rewritten engineering truth.

failures.title: CONTROL HOLD displaced product work
failures.required_rule: Only a typed hold with blocks_active_workpack=true stops the active engineering workpack.

failures.title: Generated report used too close to authority semantics
failures.required_rule: Generated reports may summarize/evidence but cannot silently become source of engineering truth.

failures.title: Known SW2018 API failure rediscovered
failures.required_rule: Known toolchain constraints become persistent operating standards/regression tests.

failures.title: Books/standards not bound to decision applicability
failures.required_rule: Sources need role, revision/version, applicability and links to requirement/calculation/decision when used.

failures.title: Local PASS confused with product/release PASS
Workpack target mislabeled as pre-execution blocker
failures.required_rule: A closure target of the ACTIVE workpack must not use blocks_active_workpack=true unless it genuinely prevents starting that workpack.

failures.title: Mutation executed without scope-bound human authorization
failures.required_rule: ENGINEERING_MUTATION, CONTROL_MUTATION and PROMOTION require explicit authorization bound to workpack, action class, contract, Operator Lock, Completion Frontier and input identities.
